---
title: "Index label misuse"
index-labels:
  symbol: "Zeichen"
  see: ""
indexes:
  - name: notes
    title: Index of Notes
    index-labels: "siehe"
  - name: sources
    title: Index of Sources
    index-labels:
      - see: "siehe"
filters:
  - index
---

Every `index-labels:` written in this document is written wrongly, and each
place writes a different mistake: the document's own map names a key this
extension does not print and gives a key it does print an empty value, and
neither index writes a map at all — the first writes a string where a map
belongs and the second a list. So this is a document of mistakes rather than
one to copy: what it demonstrates is that each is reported where it was
written, and that every word falls back to the English one this extension has
always printed.

## The first index {#site-first}

A term filing under a letter: [Osprey]{.index}. One filing under none:
[%percent]{.index}.

A cross-reference pointing at the first: [Harrier]{.index see="Osprey"}, and
one pointing further: [Goshawk]{.index see-also="Osprey"}.

## The second index {#site-second}

A term filing under a letter: [Kittiwake]{.index index="sources"}. One filing
under none: [+plussign]{.index index="sources"}.

Its own two cross-references: [Fulmar]{.index index="sources" see="Kittiwake"}
and [Petrel]{.index index="sources" see-also="Kittiwake"}.
